name: B's Living Quarters (Back Room)
description: A small living space behind the supermarket where B lives. It has a narrow bed, a mini fridge, a microwave, and a small table. Boxes of inventory are stacked along one wall. A door leads directly to the shop floor.

items.name: Inventory Ledger
items.description: A worn notebook where B tracks daily sales and restocking needs.

items.name: Mini Fridge
items.description: A small personal fridge with B's meals and some drinks.

conditions.description: A cramped but functional living space. The hum of the shop's refrigeration units is audible.
